pass: Refuses the elves' terms outright, with contempt for elves. Does not turn back, agree to talk or show them any mercy. Ordering that the captive children in the village be taken alive is a plus.

earlier: Vesh is the Demon Lord, riding on the back of one of her great spiders toward the village of the elves, at the head of her army.
She has hated the elves and their leader for a very long time.
The elves hold a number of strange children captive in their village. Vesh means to take those children alive.

dialogue.spoken: My Lord, the elves sent an envoy under a white flag. Their elder offers terms if you turn the army back: gold, land, a treaty. Will you hear him?
